notes: ACME Flame Design inverse (oxidizer-into-fuel) flames. Fuel is ethylene (the 'XC2H4' columns), diluted with N2. O2 from 'XO2' (mole fraction, x100, up to ~85%); pressure from 'pmean (atm)'. No per-run outcome or fire-safety metric. Rows where XO2 is 'RAMP' (O2 ramped during the test) have O2 left blank and are not plotted.
